How the buying price is estimated

Price offered to Bharat Harvest = MRP × (1 − margin %). The high end of the margin range gives the lowest buying price, the low end gives the highest. When a supplier has no MRP of its own, the product's market MRP range is used. Margins are research estimates from retail spreads and dealer norms, not quoted prices: confirm with each supplier before ordering.
